claims.scope: DS15135 full electrical chapter48–96 text read, selected visual checks, exact LQFP64/temperature6 constraints. Bounded contracts, not exhaustive scalar transcription or electrical qualification.

contracts.detail: Use exact suffix6: ambient-40..85C and junction-40..105C; larger family/suffix3 thermal ranges do not extend this part. General VDD/VDDA2.7..3.6V and HCLK/PCLK maximum144MHz. Preserve conditions, units, min/typ/max and guarantee provenance per row: typical values/curves are design guidance, many tables characterization/design rather than production test. Absolute maxima are stress limits, not operating permission. DS48 default min/max guarantee is production testing on 100% of devices at TJ=25 C and selected TJmax under worst specified conditions, unless a footnote states characterization, simulation or design. Characterization min/max represent mean +/- 3 sigma. Apply each row exception explicitly.

All supply/ground pins connect to appropriate domains. Supply scheme requires local ceramic decoupling; VCAP2.2uF with ESR<20mOhm at3MHz and rated voltage>=10V. Preserve VREF/VDDA and per-domain differences; board schematic connectivity is not measured rail quality. USB full electrical range3.0..3.6V differs from general2.7V functionality. VDDA decoupling is 4.7 uF plus n x 100 nF. Table17 footnote1 guarantees functionality after RESET release down to PDR minimum, without extending every peripheral specification. With BORH_EN=0, POR/PDR rising thresholds are 2.56..2.64 V and falling thresholds 2.53..2.61 V (characterization). Reset temporization max463 us is design-specified from POR crossing to NRST pull-up activation.

Apply literal pin IO structure and active analog/pull configuration, not universal5V tolerance. Normal TT inputs limitedVDD+0.3; higher FT input voltage requires disabled pulls and function-specific limits. Current injection is abnormal stress, not a normal design allowance. DS70 lists zero-negative-injection susceptibility for PA4/PA5 and a named set including PB3/4/5/6/12/13/14,PC13/14/15,PH0; do not use absolute-5mA as functional immunity. Package IO-label divergences remain unresolved. Normal non-TT maximum is MIN(VDD+3.6 V,5.5 V). Absolute FT maximum is MIN(VDD+4.0 V,6.0 V), reduced to4 V with analog option or enabled pulls; absolute VREF+-VDDA maximum is0.4 V. These are separate from normal analog limits. I2C open-drain disables but retains the PMOS, so external pull-up voltage still obeys pin limits. Injection susceptibility Table46 is characterization only.

Stress ceilings: total supply/ground200mA, per supply/ground pin100mA, perIO20mA and aggregateIO140mA, with distribution constraints. Normal output levels impose current-dependent VOL/VOH, and PC13/14/15 source capability is3mA shared. PC14/15 voltage specifications use0.5mA. Include MCU current plus output currents and thermal dissipation; no pin count multiplication of individual maxima.

OSPEED values represent slew/loading constraints, not guaranteed peripheral throughput. DS74 table excludesPC13, usesTJ125C and2.7..3.6V; raw OSPEED10/11 (high/very-high) require compensation; raw01 has no such footnote. At50/30/10pF, raw0 Fmax4/4/4MHz;raw1 12/12/12;raw2 45/50/55;raw3 90/96/110. Duty45..55% and rise+fall<=2T/3 qualify maxima. Actual board load, pin-specific restrictions and functional clocks still gate use. Table50 is specified by design, not production-tested.

NRST permanent pull-up30..50kOhm, max filtered pulse50ns and min nonfiltered pulse350ns leave intermediate pulse widths unqualified. EXTI minimum detection pulse20ns is a pad/event source limit, not guaranteed ISR service rate or lossless DMA throughput. Preserve one physical EXTI-line owner across ports and consumers.

Power tables require exact clocks/cache/prefetch/code location/peripheral state, IO loading and temperature; no additive universal consumption budget. Wake table30 values are typical, event-to-first-instruction, not upper-bound service deadlines. USART/LPUART table31 gives4.8us typical/6.6us max for48MHzHSIDIV3 Stop0/1 source conditions; compose with framing, clock error and RX buffering, not whole application wake completion. Rendered DS58 confirms Table31 Typ/Max cells span Stop0 and Stop1; 4.8/6.6 us are shared, design-specified, not production-tested. Table31 baud-budget wake metric is distinct from Table30 event-to-first-instruction timing.

HSE crystal/startup and LSE crystal/startup depend on actual external components/layout; typical2ms/2s startup values are not maximum timeout guarantees. LSE low-drive and analog-bypass restrictions plusPC13 coupling from ES2.2 apply. HSI drift includes temperature+voltage; PSI frequencies above144MHz require allowed division before restricted destinations. LSI range29.4..33.6kHz across-40..130C is conservative encompassing suffix6; nominal32kHz does not bound watchdog timeout. PSI division uses PSIK or PSIDIV4. The LSI temperature envelope is characterization only;31.4..32.6 kHz at VDD3.3 V/TJ30 C is production-tested. The wider-temperature row does not clearly repeat the voltage condition.

Program/erase timing and endurance depend on operation, voltage, temperature and cycle history. DS gives128bit user or16bitOTP/EDATA programming20us typical160us max; bank/mass erase68/135ms max; programming2.65..3.6V does not extend overall standard operating range.10kcycle endurance is qualified by table41; retention10years at125C/1kcycle versus30years85C/1kcycle or55C/10kcycle are distinct cases, not universal30years. Exact EDATA mode geometry remains FLASH contract. Endurance and retention are characterization only; endurance condition is TJ=-40..140 C, which does not extend suffix6 operating range.

ADC supply2.7..3.6V, VREF+2.5..VDDA, input0..VREF+, clock8..36MHz. Sample time and source impedance depend on resolution, leakage, temperature and PCB capacitance;2.25MSPS headline uses12bits/36MHz/SMP2.5/RAIN47Ohm/CPCB22pF. Recommended calibration after power-up; regulator startup10us max precedes ADC startup. Accuracy table measured after calibration/nooversampling onLQFP64; ENOB10.7 is typical, not12bit accuracy. Curve-based source-impedance values are not fully digitized. The 2.25/4.5 MSPS entries are typical values for slow channels in a design-specified table, not production tests. Table54 accuracy is characterization only and warns of degradation for packages without VREF- pad. Graphs78/79 use TJ140 C and VDD=VDDA=2.7 V, beyond suffix6 maximum junction temperature.

VREFINT sampling minimum4.3us and startup max4.4us; temperature sampling minimum13us and buffer startup max25.2us. Calibration references30C/3.3V and140C/3.3V require actual VDDA scaling and exact calibration word access; typical slope alone is not per-device calibrated temperature.

Buffer-on range0.2V..VDDA-0.2V and load constraints differ from unbuffered0..VREF+ with10.3..16kOhm output impedance. Normal settling/wake, sample-hold capacitance and timing are mode-specific. tTRIMminimum50us and accuracy/monotonicity are distinct;12-bit code does not imply12-bit monotonicity (DS states10bit). PA5 identity conflict and board load remain open.

Comparator delays require signal step/overdrive and speed mode; startup5us high-speed/20us medium maximum and scaler250us maximum are separate. COMP1/2 simultaneous use prohibited onRevZ by ES2.4.1. OPAMP load500uA/PGA270uA and50pF, output headroom, gain bandwidth, slew and gain error conditions apply; scalar bandwidth is not arbitrary closed-loop stability qualification.

I3C SDR12.5MHz requires OSPEED10/compensation and specific open-drain timing; I2C Fm+ current needsFT_f pads, analog filter rejects pulses below50ns and passes above160ns with middle band unspecified. USART synchronous/ SPI/I2S rates are role-specific and depend on30pF loading/compensation/OSPEED. Preserve every setup/hold constraint and ES SPI RDY limits; do not infer asynchronous UART rates from USART SPI-mode table. I3C table64 also requires voltage scaling range1 and is characterization only. ES2.8.1 requires I2C kernel period no longer than transmitter minimum setup time (4/10/20 MHz minimum for250/100/50 ns examples). ES2.10.1 restricts noninteger LPUART clock/baud ratios between3 and4; see LPUART errata gates. SPI RDY erratum thresholds are SCK>2x/6x/14x APB for8..15/16..23/24..32-bit data.

USB transceiver electrical range3.0..3.6V, functionality2.7V with degraded characteristics; internal matching means no external series termination required by DS. JTAG34MHz andSWD71MHz are characterization maxima under specified output/load conditions, not automatic safe probe settings. Current task does not activate/debug hardware. Debug timing conditions are OSPEED10, CL30 pF and measurement at0.5 VDD.

Exact LQFP64 body10x10mm, lead span12x12mm,pitch0.5mm,maxheight1.60mm; mechanical tolerances and drawing notes retained. LQFP64 thermal resistance JA45.3,JB27.6,JC14.2C/W are table values requiring actual board/environment qualification. TJ=TA+PD*theta; I/O dissipation sums VOL*IOL and(VDDIO-VOH)*IOH (visualformula), with internal power included. Do not substitute absolute150C for suffix6 TJ105C. Thermal table cites JESD51-2 natural convection.

EMC/ESD/injection/latch-up values characterize stated test conditions, not application certification or immunity. LQFP64 HBM exceptionPC15 is3100V versus4000V for other pins perDS69 footnote; no permission to conduct destructive electrical tests follows from this source survey. LQFP64 CDM is1000 V versus1250 V for other packages. Table44 heading says design-specified while its footnote1 says characterization; preserve that provenance discrepancy.

conflicts.detail: DS48 typical-data boilerplate refers1.62..3.6V but exact general table51 gives2.7..3.6V. OPAMP analog row gives2.5V minimum and flashprogram2.65V; these do not lower product standard operating voltage. The Table17 reset-release/PDR exception is retained in supply_and_decoupling; it does not by itself extend all peripheral specifications.

DS61 prose says4..48MHz crystal while table34 says4..50MHz. Preserve boundary conflict; do not silently admit49/50MHz crystal based solely on one source statement. PSI reference table also lists HSE25 or50 MHz without identifying crystal versus bypass.
DS76 table53 lists4.5MSPS at6bits/36MHz/SMP2.5; DS79 graph labels3.6MSPS, which agrees with DS77 tS+1.5+N giving10cycles. Both values visually/source-bound; no4.5MSPS admission.
DS84 visually printsRL>=5Ohm in several accuracy rows but5kOhm inTUE/SNR and normal-load requirements elsewhere, plus25kOhm for loadtoVDDA. Do not use5Ohm as drive capability.
DS83 figure text saysBOFFx inDAC_CR; existing exact DAC contract usesMCRMODE fields. Retain diagram family wording rather than inventing BOFF.

DS87 includes nonexistentTIM5/16/17 and genericexternalclockfTIM/2; exact timer source contracts impose instance-specific filters and ratios. DS88 IWDG prescaler shows3bits/alias6or7 while exact watchdog source contract must govern any wider field. Do not derive instances or timer admission from this family timing footnote. Exact overview lists TIM2/TIM12/TIM15.

DS89 operating conditions cross-reference saysnotfound; DS93 saysTablexx. SPI DS91 measurement0.5VDD differs from diagram notesDS92/93 using0.3/0.7VDD; preserve timing qualification ambiguity. DS91 TSCK formula referencesPCLK while independent SPI kernel clock exists; no unconditional use ofPCLK in divisor calculations.

Rendered DS95/96 captions say JTAG/SWD but the figures show SPI CPHA/CPOL/NSS/MOSI/MISO timing labels. Drawing IDs DT40458V2/DT40459V2 also occur in SPI slave figures on DS92. This is a source diagram defect, not text extraction damage. Tables remain separate evidence; these copied figures cannot define SWD turnarounds.
DS62 listsLSEDRV00low-drive capability; ES2.2.3 says low drive not functional onZ/Y. ES2.2.1analog bypass limitation and2.2.2PC13coupling likewise restrict datasheet oscillator envelope.

DS72 excludesPC13/14/15 from ordinary drive and gives shared3mAsource; table48excludesonlyPC14/15 and table50excludesonlyPC13. Preserve simultaneous restrictions; no generic table overrides specific low-drive/oscillator restrictions.

DS53 printsVREFINT_CAL address08FFF810..08FFF812, an inclusive3byte span unlike usual16bit SDK calibration access; exact source/calibration-width reconciliation remains required. Do not read a3byte unaligned word because of the table endpoint. RM141 allocates32-bit slots at F810(VREFINT),F814(TS_CAL1),F818(TS_CAL2), while DS81 TS_CAL ranges are two bytes. Slot width versus value width remains distinct and unresolved for the DS VREFINT endpoint.

DS63 factory HSI frequency at3.3 V/TJ30 C is144.07..145.08 MHz, production-tested, exceeding DS51 maximum HCLK144 MHz if used undivided. Preserve this source tension; nominal144 MHz alone does not prove maximum-frequency compliance.
